description: Configure Resend webhook secret environment variable
steps: Verificar con usuario que tiene configurada: RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Add RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET to .env.example with description: '# Resend webhook signing secret (from Resend dashboard > Webhooks)'

description: Create email tracking service for webhook events
steps: Define ResendWebhookEvent type with fields: type, created_at, data (email_id, from, to, subject)
Implement processResendWebhookEvent(event) that handles: delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, complained
For each event: find EmailRecipient by resendId, update status and appropriate timestamp (deliveredAt, openedAt, clickedAt)
After updating recipient, call updateCampaignStats(campaignId) from email-campaign-service
Also check WorkflowExecution by resendId and update if found
Import Webhook from 'svix' for signature verification
Implement POST handler that: reads raw body, verifies signature using RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Parse webhook payload and call processResendWebhookEvent from tracking service
Return 200 on success, 400 on invalid signature, 500 on error

description: Extend campaign service with history and detail queries
steps: In email-campaign-service.ts, add getCampaignsWithStats(educatorId, filters) that includes aggregated stats
Add filters support: dateFrom, dateTo (for createdAt range)
Add getCampaignRecipients(campaignId, options) with pagination: skip, take
Accept props: totalRecipients, sentCount, deliveredCount, openedCount, clickedCount, failedCount
Display stats in a Card with grid of stat items
Use appropriate icons from lucide-react for each stat
Accept props: recipients array with student info and tracking timestamps
Use shadcn Table component with columns: Nombre, Email, Estado, Enviado, Entregado, Abierto
Display status with Badge component (color-coded by status)
Get educatorId from session, redirect if not authenticated
Display Table with columns: Nombre, Plantilla, Curso, Fecha, Estado, Destinatarios, Abiertos
Add filter controls: course selector, status selector, date range picker
Make each row clickable to navigate to /educator/communications/[campaignId]
Handle empty state with message and link to create new campaign
Get campaignId from params, educatorId from session
Fetch campaign with getCampaignById, return 404 if not found
Display campaign info: name, template subject, course, scheduledAt/sentAt
If status is 'scheduled', show Cancel button (implement cancel action)

description: Create campaign actions for cancel and filters
steps: Implement cancelCampaignAction(campaignId) - updates status to 'cancelled', validates ownership
Implement getCampaignsAction(filters) for client-side filtering with revalidation
